dryer.title: Dryer
dryer.advanced: Advanced: fans, flaps, readings and the dryer log
dryer.threshold: Dries by itself when the box's humidity is above
dryer.cooldown_rule: The fans run until both heater outlets are at most 45 °C and have stopped cooling — at most 10 min.
dryer.after_stop: After it stops, the fans run until the heater has cooled.
dryer.log_none: The dryer log did not come back. Try again.
dryer.fault_cooling: The fans cool it down. The unit accepts Clear once it is cool.
dryer.fault.not_heating: The heater stopped: it did not warm up.
dryer.fault.response: The heater stopped: the outlets heated faster than the heater can explain (a stopped fan or a blocked duct?).
dryer.fault.sides: The heater stopped: the two outlets read more than 15 °C apart.
dryer.fault.chamber_over: The heater stopped: the chamber went over its limit.
dryer.fault.chamber_stale: The heater stopped: no plausible chamber reading.
dryer.fault.ntc: The heater stopped: an outlet sensor is invalid.
dryer.fault.mains: The heater stopped: the mains is absent or implausible.
dryer.fault.cutout: The thermal cutout tripped. Only a power cycle clears it.
dryer.fault.heat: The heater stopped: the gate latched.
dryer.fault.fans: The heater stopped: the fans did not start.
dryer.fault.flaps: The heater stopped: the flaps did not close.
dryer.fault.lid: The heater stopped: the box did not warm up — is the lid open?
dryer.fault.unknown: The heater stopped. This page does not know the reason ({name}).
chart.title: Temperature and humidity
events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Newest first
events.stop_lost: The head load's stop did not reach the printer. Its heaters turn off on their own after 5 idle minutes. If the page then says that the printer is already loading a head, send AUTO_FEEDING_BATCH ACTION=STOP in the console.
top.history_error: The history is not being recorded: {e}
tag.pending: pending — read when the spool turns
tag.forgotten: forgotten — set the spool with Edit spool

refuse.length_max: The length must be at most {max} mm.
refuse.stop_all: Stop all needs at least one lane, from 1 to {max}.
refuse.which: The flap must be the bottom or the rear one.
refuse.mode: The dryer mode must be manual, humidity or print.
refuse.lane: The lane must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
refuse.no_action: This page has no command for that action.

toast.tag_rearmed: Lane {n} will read its tag the next time its spool turns.
lane.empty_hint: Put a spool in bay {n} and push the filament in until the unit takes it.
dryer.mode_warming: box not steady yet, humidity not read
dryer.mode_stopped: stopped after {n} failed cycles: check the lid
dryer.warn_title: Dry on its own when the box gets humid
dryer.warn_1: The unit will heat on its own, even with the printer off, for days or months.
dryer.warn_2: Keep it in a ventilated place, away from anything that burns, with nothing on the lid and nothing over the air vents.
dryer.warn_3: The temperature follows the most fragile material in the box. A lane with no known material counts as PLA (45 °C). Check the materials in Edit spool.
dryer.warn_4: Keep the lid closed. If the box does not dry in {n} cycles in a row, the mode stops and says so.
dryer.warn_4_unknown: Keep the lid closed. If the box does not dry in several cycles in a row (dry_max_failures), the mode stops and says so.
dryer.warn_5: A spool on its holder whose strand does not reach the insert sensor is not seen.
dryer.warn_6: Stopping an automatic cycle by hand turns the mode off.
dryer.warn_stops: The automatic cycle running now stops when you enable this mode.
dryer.confirm_stop_auto: Stop the automatic cycle? In the humidity mode this turns the mode off.
dryer.confirm_mode_stops_auto: Change the mode? The automatic cycle running now stops.

step.out_unknown: Take the spool with no material out of bay {key}
step.move: Take the {what} out of bay {from} and put it in bay {key}
step.put: Put a new {what} spool for color {n} in bay {key}
step.put_back: Put the {what} you took out in bay {key}
step.check: Check that the spool in bay {key} is right for color {n}
step.sub.out: The file does not use this spool, and the bay is needed.
step.sub.out_unknown: The planner does not use a spool with no material. If it fits, click the bay and define it first.
step.sub.put: A new spool for color {n}. The page moves on by itself when it reads the tag.
step.sub.put_back: It was ejected already: only putting it in is left.
step.sub.move_empty: The bay it goes to is empty: just move the spool.
step.sub.check: The page cannot tell this spool's color: press Done when it is right.
step.sub.in_hand: The spool of bay {key} is in your hand: put the spool for color {n} in the bay.

step.sub.check_unsure: The page cannot compare this spool with every color that prints from this bay (color {n} among them): press Done when it is right.
step.sub.put_over_unknown: Bay {key} holds a spool with no material: eject it and put the spool for color {n}, or define its material (click the bay) and press Done to use it.

step.sub.put_over_mixed: Bay {key} holds a {what} spool, but colors that print from it are {other}: one spool cannot print them all, so eject it and put the right one, or pick other bays.
step.sub.put_fresh: Color {n} asked for a new spool: put it in bay {key}, in place of the one there.
step.sub.check_no_file_colour: The file gives color {n} no color, so the page cannot compare: press Done when the spool is right.
step.sub.put_over_any: Bay {key} holds a {what} spool, not color {n}'s color: eject it and put a spool of that color, or press Done to print color {n} with the {what}.
step.sub.put_over: Bay {key} holds a {what} spool, not color {n}'s {want}: eject it and put a {want} one, or press Done to print color {n} with the {what}.
